query: I have a 49‑year‑old female inpatient. Among female inpatients aged 44–54 with intracranial hemorrhage, what are median (IQR) risk score and 90‑day mortality? Compare major complication rate and median survivor LOS to female inpatients 44–54, and give matched risk percentile.
final_sql:
WITH full_risk AS (
  SELECT predicted_mortality
  FROM ... full cohort
),
ich_median AS (
  SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(median_risk, 0.5) AS ich_median_risk FROM ich...
),
non_ich_median AS ( ... )
SELECT
  ich_median_risk,
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(predicted_mortality, 0.5) FROM full_risk) AS full_median,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM full_risk WHERE predicted_mortality <= ich_median_risk) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM full_risk AS ich_percentile;
